title: Bemutatom a munkatársamat: Accusative + Possessive Together

sections.title: Stacking two endings you already know
sections.content: To introduce someone, use bemutat ("to introduce") — and when the person you're introducing carries a possessive suffix, the accusative -t simply stacks on after it: munkatársam ("my colleague") becomes munkatársamat as an object, főnököm ("my boss") becomes főnökömet. Nothing changes about either suffix — the possessive comes first, and the accusative attaches to it exactly like it would to any noun.

items.english: I'd like to introduce my colleague, Petra.
I'd like to introduce my team.

sections.content: The order never changes: stem, then possessive suffix, then accusative — munkatárs + am + at, never munkatárs + at + am. Say the possessive-suffixed form to yourself first (a munkatársam), then just add -t on the end.
